description: STL mesh check: open edges, non-manifold edges, inverted normals — Checks a binary or ASCII STL mesh of up to 4000 triangles for a 3D-printing or CAD agent: open (boundary) edges, edges shared by more than two triangles, inconsistent winding, degenerate and duplicate triangles, normals that disagree with the vertex order, and an inside-out (negative signed volume) closed mesh, with triangle indices as witnesses. Input is base64 of the STL file (up to 200084 bytes

data.description: Padded base64 of the STL file, binary or ASCII.

weldTolerance.description: Vertices closer than this (grid-snapped, model units) are treated as the same vertex. Default 0: exact float32 equality.

name: mesh-check
